For Petitioner : Mr.K.Chandra  For Respondents 1to4 : Mr.E.Vijay Anand, A.G.P.
 For Respondent No. 5 : Mrs.Sudharsasna Sundar  *****
 ORDER (Order of the Court was delivered by D.KRISHNAKUMAR, J.)

The learned Additional Government Pleader appearing for the respondents informed to this Court that under Sec.18 of the Land Acquisition Act read with 8(1) of Industrial Purpose Act, the matter was referred to the civil Court for determining the enhancement of compensation to the petitioner.
2. Learned counsel appearing for the petitioner also not controverted the said statement.
Recording the said submission, the writ petition stands dismissed as infructuous.
No costs.
(D.K.K.J. )
